prompt: Plan a 4-week project to build an internal expense-approval dashboard. I'll lead it, it moves KR1, hard deadline is 14 Nov, scope is the fixed constraint.
assertions: Includes a charter with scope, out-of-scope and acceptance criteria

Does not create anything before approval
